items.summary: Nvidia's strong revenue forecast revived the AI trade and lifted the Nasdaq and S&P 500, but Wall Street's focus is quickly shifting to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech. Fresh inflation data and a resilient labour market have complicated the interest rate outlook, leaving investors weighing AI optimism against monetary policy risks.

items.summary: AI adoption is pushing customers to spend more on cybersecurity tools from companies such as CrowdStrike and Okta

items.summary: The settlement, announced on Wednesday, would impose some of Meta's toughest restrictions yet on how teenagers use Facebook and Instagram.

items.title: Sports Direct founder attacks Burnham's 'populist' High Street plans
items.summary: In a letter, the entrepreneur accuses the prime minister of "jumping on 'everyday fixes' or bandwagons" with his latest cost of living and retail policies.

items.title: Hindalco Industries expands specialty Alumina portfolio
items.summary: Hindalco Industries commissioned a new facility for specialty alumina in Belagavi. This new plant will produce flame-retardant products for various safety applications. The company is also planning several more specialty alumina facilities soon. These expansions will significantly increase Hindalco's total specialty alumina capacity.

items.title: Demand for vaccines surges as H1N1, other influenza cases see a sharp rise
items.summary: Demand for flu vaccines has significantly increased this year. At-home vaccination services are seeing a substantial rise in bookings. Rapid testing requests are also growing from various Indian cities. This surge is driven by elevated viral spread and increased awareness. Experts recommend annual vaccinations and usual protective measures.

items.title: NTPC plans to treble capacity to 244GW by 2037, invest ₹16.86 lakh crore
items.summary: NTPC plans to nearly triple its power generation capacity by 2037. The company will invest significantly in renewable and nuclear power expansion. This investment will also cover battery and pumped storage systems. NTPC aims to contribute substantially to the nation's nuclear energy target.

items.title: Banks, companies better positioned to weather next downturn: CS Setty, SBI, Chairman
items.summary: The chairman of the State Bank of India underscores the nation's economic resilience, emphasizing the bank's robust standing in the financial sector. With a growth forecast of 7.5% and inflation consistent with RBI predictions, SBI is gearing up for a remarkable 14-15% rise in credit, driven by retail and SME sectors. The bank is also focusing on enhancing its fee income while aiming for a 1% return on assets.

items.title: ACME Solar raises Rs 1,571 crore for 300 MW Rajasthan power project
items.summary: ACME Solar Holdings announced ₹1,571 crore project funding from IIFCL. This financing will develop ACME Renewtech Sixth's 300 MW assured peak power project. The company has now secured ₹10,976 crore in financing this fiscal year. The project's power purchase agreement is with Solar Energy Corporation of India. This agreement is for twenty-five years at a tariff of ₹6.28 per unit.

items.title: India needs Rs 30 lakh crore to hit 500 GW clean-energy target: Pralhad Joshi
items.summary: India needs over ₹30 lakh crore investment for its 500 GW non-fossil fuel target. Domestic financial institutions and capital markets will fund much of this significant green-energy expansion. The nation has already surpassed 300 GW of installed non-fossil fuel capacity. Renewable energy capacity grew substantially in the first four months of FY27. Maharashtra is urged to showcase projects and attract global developers at BRESE 2026.

items.title: HDFC Bank's CEO call gains urgency as Sashidhar Jagdishan's term nears end
items.summary: The timeline stands in contrast to Jagdishan's previous reappointment. HDFC Bank's board had recommended a fresh three-year term for him on March 4, 2023, nearly eight months before his first tenure was due to expire. The Reserve Bank of India approved the appointment in September that year.

items.title: Oil Rises on Fresh Doubts Over US-Iran Diplomacy Outlook
items.summary: Oil rose after a report said US President Donald Trump has told mediators he’s uninterested in returning to terms of a June ceasefire deal signed with Iran, casting doubt on a sustainable increase in energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Gaana, Fenix360 team up to create direct artist-fan ecosystem
items.summary: Gaana and Fenix360 have partnered to launch a new artist-fan ecosystem. This integration combines discovery, engagement, and monetization within the Gaana app. Artists can now build digital storefronts and offer merchandise directly to fans. The platform also enables ticket sales and paid live streams for artists. This new ecosystem aims to foster stronger artist-audience connections and revenue streams.

items.title: In Graphics: Kitchen basket inflation is back
items.summary: Edible oils and eggs are also seeing higher prices. Demand for most commodities is elevated amid the onset of the festival season, even as poor monsoon rainfall and the second-order effects of the West Asia crisis continue to add pressure.

items.title: 'Croma on turnaround path as losses narrow, quality of growth gets better': CEO
items.summary: Infiniti Retail, Croma's operator, is on a strong turnaround path, significantly reducing losses. The company achieved operational profitability in FY26, swinging to a profit of ₹159 crore. Total income grew thirteen percent to ₹21,784 crore, with sales growth nearly doubling. Infiniti Retail closed thirty-five unviable stores and plans to add forty-five new outlets. Continuous cost optimization is now a habit in the business.

items.title: Singapore Airlines' board to retain final say on further Air India investment
items.summary: Singapore Airlines’ board will retain the final decision on any further investment in loss-making Air India, chairman Peter Seah told shareholders. He said the board is closely reviewing the investment and would approve additional funding only as circumstances warrant.

items.title: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh delivers his key Jackson Hole speech Friday. Here's what to expect
items.summary: Prior Fed chairs have used the speech as an opportunity to lay out broad policy frameworks and intentions.

items.title: India, Canada set $70 billion trade target, widen economic partnership
items.summary: India and Canada aim to deepen economic ties, expanding beyond goods and services. They plan to scale up bilateral trade to seventy billion dollars annually by 2030. Discussions focused on investment, financial sector cooperation, and critical minerals. Canadian investors were urged to leverage India's growing economy and talent. Both nations seek to build more resilient and inclusive economies together.

items.title: Faster KYC, nods key to boosting FDI flows: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: The minister was speaking at the end of his official visit to Japan, where he held a series of high-level engagements aimed at accelerating Japanese investment in India, strengthening industrial partnerships and expanding bilateral economic cooperation across emerging and strategic sectors. "Our focus is on process and procedures... there are very few sectors where FDI is restricted but we are open to ideas whatever industry demands... during these engagements here, new ideas have come up," Goyal said.

items.title: Zinc Rally Eases While Spreads Point to Tighter Supply on LME
items.summary: Zinc slipped from the highest level in more than four years, tracking losses in other metals while traders continue to monitor signs of supply tightness on the London Metal Exchange.

items.title: Centre allows imported coal in Rs 37,500-crore gasification scheme
items.summary: The government permits imported coal for gasification projects under a new scheme. This initiative aims to convert coal into valuable chemicals and fuels. Developers will arrange their own fuel supply, with no domestic coal guarantee provided. Foreign companies can bid but must establish a local entity if selected. The scheme offers financial support for plant and machinery costs.

items.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario 'Lake America' amid Canada trade war
items.summary: President Donald Trump signed an executive order that he said will "immediately" change the name of Lake Ontario to "Lake America."

items.summary: Two Sigma Investments’ billionaire founders are headed to another round of arbitration, the latest front in what seems to be intractable infighting at the quant trading giant.

items.title: Onion prices likely to stay firm till November despite Centre’s Rs 35/kg push
items.summary: Onion prices will likely stay firm until November despite government sales. Inferior quality of stored onions and delayed fresh crop arrival are key factors. Global onion shortages are also supporting domestic price stability. The government's price control measures follow a significant wholesale price increase. The Kanda Express transports onions from Maharashtra to major cities.

items.title: S&P retains India rating, keeps outlook stable on economic momentum
items.summary: Last year, S&P, the biggest of the global ratings firms, had raised its rating on India to 'BBB' from 'BBB-' after 18 years, citing the country's economic resilience and sustained fiscal consolidation. However, Fitch has retained its sovereign rating on India at BBB- since 2006, while Moody's has retained the same lowest investment grade of 'Baa3' since 2020. As for short-term India credit rating, S&P has maintained it at A-2, indicating that the country's capacity to meet financial commitments remains satisfactory.

items.title: Pernod Ricard weighs options for India IPO, kicks off legal process
items.summary: Pernod Ricard has confirmed that its board is evaluating a potential IPO of its Indian operations and has begun legal preparations to keep the option open. CEO Alexandre Ricard said the decision is still under discussion and will depend on the strategic rationale and potential shareholder value.

items.title: Banks, FIU-IND work on sharper framework to flag money mule accounts
items.summary: Banks are enhancing suspicious transaction reporting for money mule accounts. They aim for better analysis and pattern identification by the principal officer. Artificial intelligence and machine learning tools are now being deployed. This initiative follows parliamentary committee recommendations for accountability. The goal is to recover funds and prevent financial system misuse.

items.title: Fed's Collins says latest US inflation readings are 'mixed'
items.summary: US Federal Reserve officials offered differing views on the inflation outlook, with Boston Fed President Susan Collins calling July’s data mixed and maintaining her expectation of gradual disinflation. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack remained more hawkish, saying inflation could stay above target through next year and reiterating that a rate hike is needed.

items.title: EIH dispute: Oberoi Hotels told to deposit late chief's dividend with Delhi HC in four weeks
items.summary: Anastasia Oberoi, daughter of late hotelier PRS Oberoi and Mirjana Jojic Oberoi, had sought to restrain Oberoi Hotels from distributing the final dividend declared in its annual general meeting (AGM) held on September 26 last year, or alternatively sought a direction that the dividend so declared be placed in a separate interest-bearing account in the registry of the HC.

items.title: SK Hynix CEO says Indiana will be key memory production base by 2030, first U.S. facility now underway

items.title: Oyo parent Prism’s FY26 profit jumps over fourfold to Rs 994 crore
items.summary: Oyo parent Prism reported a substantial profit increase for fiscal 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations also saw a significant rise of fifty percent. Ebitda more than doubled, driven by higher business volumes and acquisitions. Gross booking value increased substantially, reflecting strong market performance. The company is now considering a large initial public offering.

items.title: US Fed officials keep rate hike in play as inflation clouds Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole address
items.summary: Federal Reserve officials expressed concerns about stubbornly high inflation at Jackson Hole. Some policymakers believe further interest rate increases may be necessary soon. Persistent price pressures could threaten the central bank's credibility and credibility. Inflationary mindsets might embed themselves within the economy over time. Investors await further data and signals on the monetary policy outlook.

items.title: TCS Q1 variable pay: Mid, senior employees get 60-70% while juniors receive full payout, says report
items.summary: Tata Consultancy Services has reportedly lowered variable compensation for mid- and senior-level employees in the April-June quarter, disbursing only 60-70% of eligible pay as operating margins shrink amid investments in artificial intelligence, according to a Moneycontrol report.

items.title: BPCL to get first Iraqi crude cargo as Hormuz disruption persists
items.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation will soon receive its first Iraqi crude oil shipment. This move aims to secure supplies while facing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The company is also open to purchasing more Gulf crude on a free-on-board basis. BPCL plans a ship-to-ship transfer of the Iraqi cargo near Fujairah. This diversification strategy helps maintain essential fuel supplies for the nation.

items.title: IndiaFirst Life bets on agentic AI for long-term gains, ties-up with Salesforce
items.summary: IndiaFirst Life has partnered with Salesforce to deploy autonomous AI agents across core sales and customer operations, aiming for long-term growth without immediate staff cuts.

items.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, report says
items.summary: Nvidia reportedly agreed to buy open source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as the chipmaker expands deeper into the AI ecosystem.

items.title: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility planning to double capacity, scouting for new factory site
items.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is considering doubling its annual production capacity to meet rising demand for electric three-wheelers. The Mahindra & Mahindra subsidiary currently has capacity to produce 300,000 vehicles a year across plants in Telangana, Karnataka and Uttarakhand.

items.title: HDFC Bank staff help prevent Rs 1.12-crore 'digital arrest' fraud
items.summary: HDFC Bank employees took swift action to block a potential digital scam targeting elderly clients. An attentive staff member noticed an anxious couple trying to send a hefty amount of money while on a video call with someone unknown. Reacting promptly, the bank team identified the suspicious activity and successfully protected the seniors from losing Rs 1.12 crore, showcasing their commitment to customer safety.

items.summary: The National Company Law Tribunal approved a repayment plan for Essel Group founder Subhash Chandra. Corporate borrowers remain liable for their debts, and creditors retain recovery avenues. This case is an exceptional personal-guarantor resolution, not a corporate debt write-off.

The chipmaker reported $96.2 billion in second-quarter revenue and expects about $108 billion in the current quarter. Its 70% fiscal 2028 growth outlook further strengthened investor confidence in the AI trade.

items.summary: ESDS Software Solution raised Rs 216 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 720 crore IPO, opening August 28. Priced at Rs 408-429, the fresh issue will fund cloud computing equipment, data centre infrastructure and corporate needs.

The India-UK Free Trade Agreement is expected to further boost performance and innovation.
